name: theoremgate
description: Complete Codex-native pipeline for governed theoretical ML research, evidence, experiments, manuscripts, review, and venue packaging.

interface.shortDescription: Develop audited theory and complete research papers.
interface.longDescription: Starts immediately and autonomously executes direction selection, discovery, proof preflight, adversarial governance, bounded proof correction and contribution strengthening, honest paper routing, full-proof or evidence appendices, experiments, manuscript writing, review, revision, and automatic venue packaging with the active Codex model.
defaultPrompt: Use TheoremAudit to run a new full governed research-to-paper pipeline and produce the strongest evidence-supported paper.
Use TheoremAudit to start a theory-first research run from my idea or research question.
Use TheoremAudit to open the research workspace and show the latest run.
Use TheoremAudit to audit my latest run and identify the next evidence or proof blocker.
Use TheoremAudit Proof Repair to correct an audited theorem defect and rerun the affected proof stages.
Use TheoremAudit Contribution Strengthening when an accepted result does not yet meet my selected publication goal.
Use TheoremAudit to continue my governed research pipeline autonomously from its persisted stage.
Use TheoremAudit to finish every full run with the strongest honest paper, including a null-result research report when no theorem survives audit.
